documents.population: Internationale Bewerbende (non-German applicants) to undergraduate programmes (Bachelor/Staatsexamen) via the International Office
documents.notes: LMU 'Studienbewerbung für internationale Bewerbende'. The page is in transition: from the summer semester 2027 LMU works with uni-assist (VPD) and a new application portal opens in December 2026; the application form shown is 'nur gültig für Wintersemester 2026/27' (an application-cycle label) and is not drafted. Not drafted (no vocabulary kind): proof of German language skills (uncertified copy), APS certificate (school/university certificates from China, India, Vietnam), Bavarian recognition notice for IB holders without the final certificate, marriage certificate / proof of name change. The page states that references, recommendation letters and internship certificates are not required for the application to the International Office.
